scope: Renewal of three existing conditional claims; no broader public promises or runtime changes.

reviews.evidence: Guest browser calculations produced expected profit, margin and markup on English, French, Swahili and Hausa profit-margin routes without sign-in or paid entitlement.
limitations: Representative routes and the existing Pro boundary were checked; this is not a claim that every feature or future feature is free.

reviews.evidence: Canonical signup collects name/email/password/country, calls AfroAuth.signup, and the client invokes Supabase signUp with tier free. No payment call or card field is in that path. Browser checks verified signup navigation, the signed-out Pro state, and a synthetic free account offered separate plan selection.
limitations: No real account was created, email sent, provider checkout performed or live signup availability claimed.
Synthetic profile tests establish UI behavior, not production account provisioning.

reviews.decision: retain only existing route-and-test-scoped wording; approve no speed or universal-device claim
reviews.evidence: Chromium profit-margin checks passed at 320/375/768px, including 200% zoom, dark mode, reduced motion and keyboard navigation. Two-route constrained-network smoke returned WARN, with no overflow or sub-16px controls but slow rendering and high layout shift.
limitations: Local browser simulation, not carrier-field or production performance proof.
Warnings exclude instant, fast-on-2G, universal-browser, fully-offline or all-route support claims.

browser_tests.command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/auth-funnel.spec.js tests/e2e/pro-ux.spec.js tests/e2e/profit-margin-vip.spec.js --project=chromium --workers=1 --grep 'calculates margins|mobile, 200%|homepage Sign Up Free|signed-out state explains|free account state'
